issues.description: The Farm class in the solution exposes the animals list as a public field (public List<Animal> animals;), while the problem statement's UML and textual instructions indicate the animals attribute should be encapsulated (private) and accessed via getter and setter. This visibility mismatch can confuse students about the intended encapsulation and whether direct field access is acceptable versus using the getter/setter pattern they are explicitly asked to implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the animals field in Farm to be private (private List<Animal> animals;), keep the provided getter and setter, and ensure all internal access uses the getter/setter. Update any solution code that accesses the field directly to use the getter/setter so the implementation matches the UML and the instructional text about encapsulation.
